editorial.blurb: This hidden gem near the Fire Department treats you like family while serving some of the freshest, most flavorful sushi in the city—with genuinely welcoming service that's completely unpretentious.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about their sushi of the month deal and special rotating dishes like the Asian Pot Roast (not always on the menu); regulars discover a different favorite roll each visit, so don't hesitate to ask the staff for current recommendations.
